segments.sn56.30:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā therā bhikkhū cetesu [cetiyesu (syā.)] viharanti sahañcanike [sahajaniye (sī. syā. kaṃ.)].
segments.sn56.30:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena sambahulānaṃ therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ maṇḍalamāḷe sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarākathā udapādi –
segments.sn56.30:1.3: “yo nu kho, āvuso, dukkhaṃ passati dukkhasamudayampi so passati, dukkhanirodhampi passati, dukkhanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadampi passatī”ti.
segments.sn56.30:2.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā gavampati thero [gavampatitthero (syā. kaṃ.)] bhikkhū etadavoca –
segments.sn56.30:2.2: “sammukhā metaṃ, āvuso, bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ –
segments.sn56.30:2.3: ‘yo, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ passati dukkhasamudayampi so passati, dukkhanirodhampi passati, dukkhanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadampi passati.
segments.sn56.30:2.4: Yo dukkhasamudayaṃ passati dukkhampi so passati, dukkhanirodhampi passati, dukkhanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadampi passati.
segments.sn56.30:2.5: Yo dukkhanirodhaṃ passati dukkhampi so passati, dukkhasamudayampi passati, dukkhanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadampi passati.
segments.sn56.30:2.6: Yo dukkhanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ passati dukkhampi so passati, dukkhasamudayampi passati, dukkhanirodhampi passatī’”ti.
segments.sn56.30:3.3: Mittaṃ tathā ca loko ca, pariññeyyaṃ gavampatīti.

lines: Yo, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ passati, dukkhasamudayampi so passatītiādi ekapaṭivedhavasena vuttaṃ, imasmiñhi sutte ekapaṭivedhova kathito.
